title: EMS BMS Communication Configuration
description: CAN bus and timing configuration for Battery Management System (BMS) communication. The BMS uses CAN 2.0B/FD with DBC Layer 2 decoding. CAN arbitration IDs range from 0x98FF0003 to 0x98FF0903.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

can.description: CAN bus interface and protocol settings.

interface.description: CAN network interface name. Use 'can0' for physical hardware or 'vcan0' for virtual CAN during development.

bitrate.description: CAN bus bitrate in bits per second. Must match the BMS hardware configuration.

fd_enabled.description: Enable CAN FD (Flexible Data-rate) mode for higher bandwidth messages. Requires CAN FD compatible hardware.

dbc_path.description: Filesystem path to the DBC file for CAN signal decoding. Relative to the EMS install root.

base_id.description: Base CAN arbitration ID for the BMU master (e.g., 0x98FF0003). Slave IDs are computed as base_id + (cluster * 0x100 + rack).

timing.description: Message polling intervals and timeout thresholds for BMS CAN communication.

fast_cycle_ms.description: Polling interval for fast CAN messages (voltage, current, SoC). Default 300 ms.

slow_cycle_ms.description: Polling interval for slow CAN messages (temperature, alarms, status). Default 2000 ms.

timeout_ms.description: BMS communication timeout. If no message received within this window, a communication fault is raised.

fault_injection.description: Optional fault injection settings for CAN simulator testing. When present, the CAN simulator applies configured faults to emulate degraded hardware.

frame_drop_rate.description: Fraction of CAN frames to silently drop. 0.0 = no drops, 1.0 = drop all.

corrupt_data.description: Enable occasional garbled signal values in CAN frames.

corrupt_rate.description: Corruption probability per frame when corrupt_data is true. Default 0.02 in code.

stale_timeout_ms.description: Stop sending CAN frames for the target rack for this many ms after startup.

stale_rack_index.description: Which rack index goes stale when stale_timeout_ms is set. Default 0.

signal_tuning.description: Optional signal tuning overrides for CAN simulator cell voltage generation. Overrides hardcoded defaults for noise, drift, and base voltage.

noise_sigma.description: Gaussian noise standard deviation for cell voltage. Default 0.005.

drift_amplitude.description: Sinusoidal drift amplitude in volts. Default 0.15.

drift_period_s.description: Sinusoidal drift period in seconds. Default 60.0.

base_voltage.description: Base cell voltage in volts. Default 3.35.
